itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter16_verse1.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 16 Verse 1
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter16_verse1.introduction: This verse belongs to Chapter 16 of the Bhagavad Gita.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter16_verse1.scripture_text: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 16, Verse 1 teaches disciplined action, inner clarity, and devotion to the Divine as a path to liberation.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter16_verse1.philosophical_explanation: This verse contributes to Krishna's teaching on dharma, yoga, and liberation.
